use_swappable_decorator: use the swappable decorator to add swappable subcomponents to a class with default component classes
use_with_components: use with_components class method to create a ModularComponentBuilder with custom subcomponent classes
use_swap_components: use swap_components method on a ModularComponentBuilder to replace subcomponent classes after creation
use_swappables_property: use the swappables property on a ModularComponent instance to access swappable subcomponent constructors
use_make_class_swappable: use _make_class_swappable to programmatically create a new class that subclasses ModularComponent with swappable subcomponents
